issues.description: traceability字段说明限制1至7位，示例使用8位；未选择其中一项替代原文。
issues.sdk_handling: retain raw source; no invented correction

issues.sdk_handling: retain raw source; no invented correction

issues.description: Stop direction is required in the table, omitted by the HTTP example.
issues.sdk_handling: require direction according to the parameter table

issues.description: meta.code table says string while the success example uses integer 200.
issues.sdk_handling: accept both 200 and string 200

issues.description: timingPlanBasicInfos is described as string but shown as array.
issues.sdk_handling: preserve the original response data

issues.description: enable is placed in body by the table but in query by the example; body encoding is absent.
issues.sdk_handling: no set_enabled facade until verified

issues.description: Request method says GET while the HTTP request example says POST; parameter header label and form example also conflict.
issues.sdk_handling: No built-in managed-token refresh flow; caller-owned providers must use a separately verified issuer integration.

issues.description: Version-query Request Address is version/info, but its HTTP example points to encrypt/off and adds validateCode.
issues.sdk_handling: use the request address and parameter table; never issue the encryption mutation

issues.description: channelInfoList is typed Object but illustrated as an array.
issues.sdk_handling: preserve raw data

issues.description: supportCloud is typed Int but illustrated as a string.
issues.sdk_handling: preserve raw data

issues.description: Sound localization request addresses use ssl while sections 1.8/1.9 HTTP examples use scene.
issues.sdk_handling: use explicit ssl request addresses

issues.description: Same scene paths are described as lens occlusion in CN706/707 and video tampering in EN477.
issues.sdk_handling: retain neutral SCENE name; device behavior is unverified

issues.description: Wi-Fi prompt status return table declares channelNo String but example uses integer.
issues.sdk_handling: preserve raw response types

issues.description: Flow treats two 2009 responses as offline confirmation while the error table calls 2009 timeout.
issues.sdk_handling: No automatic polling or success conversion; preserve non-200 errors.

issues.description: SSID is a header String but non-ASCII encoding is unspecified.
issues.sdk_handling: Refuse unverified encodings; do not silently move to query or collect network data.

issues.description: Parameter table uses saturatio; request example uses saturation.
issues.sdk_handling: Defer the setter; retain GET response fields exactly. Do not infer a correction or send device writes to choose a spelling.

issues.description: Parameter table uses manul for manual mode; request example uses manual.
issues.sdk_handling: Defer the setter; retain GET response fields exactly. Do not infer a correction or send device writes to choose a spelling.

issues.description: videoBitRate code 22 is described as custom, but no parameter for the custom bitrate value is documented.
issues.sdk_handling: Send the documented code only when explicitly supplied; do not invent a kbps field or claim arbitrary bitrate configuration.

issues.description: expireTime response field is typed long but shown as a date string.
issues.sdk_handling: Preserve the response value without coercion or timezone inference.

issues.description: Response note describes per-address ret/status/exception while the example contains a single object without them.
issues.sdk_handling: Check data.ret only if present; preserve status/exception and raw data. Platform success is not playback readiness.

issues.description: urlId is marked optional but the effect of omission is not documented.
issues.sdk_handling: Require explicit url_id argument; accept explicit None only overseas without assigning a guessed scope. No default omission or automatic replay.

issues.description: Request timestamp prose says second while examples use 13-digit values.
issues.sdk_handling: Forward caller-supplied integer timestamps unchanged; no unit or timezone guessing.

issues.description: Per-device Request Address is /api/lapp/alarm/device/list but HTTP example uses /api/lapp/alarm/list.
issues.sdk_handling: Use the dedicated per-device Request Address.

issues.description: Original alarm enum contains :Wi-Fi Recovered with no numeric code.
issues.sdk_handling: Do not infer a missing number or publish a fabricated exhaustive enum; preserve raw types.

issues.description: v1 startTime/expireTime are described as seconds but samples use 13-digit values.
issues.sdk_handling: Preserve raw response integers without datetime conversion.

issues.description: v1 startTime/expireTime are described as seconds but samples use 13-digit values.
issues.sdk_handling: Preserve raw response integers without datetime conversion.

issues.description: Request deviceSerial is typed long while response identifiers use String and common platform APIs use string identifiers.
issues.sdk_handling: Keep the public SDK identifier as a string and send it unchanged in form; no numeric coercion or claimed live alphanumeric support.

issues.description: HTTP examples show a corrupted phone parameter label instead of phone.
issues.sdk_handling: Use the explicitly named phone parameter table field.

issues.description: MD5(AppKey#plaintext) is specified without the character encoding for its byte input.
issues.sdk_handling: Require explicit encoding in the local digest helper; facade accepts prepared digests only.

issues.description: Create/change password specifies MD5 input concatenation but not character encoding.
issues.sdk_handling: Require explicit encoding; do not derive a password from client credentials.

issues.description: Subaccount list Request Address uses account/list while its HTTP example uses account/get.
issues.sdk_handling: Use Request Address for the list operation.

issues.description: Statement add and device permission delete examples contain an extra equals sign in form values.
issues.sdk_handling: Use one normal form field encoding from the parameter table.

issues.description: API examples use uppercase permission names whereas grammar page 487 uses mixed-case names.
issues.sdk_handling: Preserve caller spelling; platform determines accepted values, no automatic case conversion.

issues.description: Subaccount token response shows a 13-digit expireTime without an independent unit definition.
issues.sdk_handling: Return the raw value; no implicit TokenProvider or expiry conversion.

issues.description: Policy page 69 omits Alarm from its list while introduction page 68 includes it.
issues.sdk_handling: Do not publish a closed enum inferred from either list; validate structure and retain caller-provided permission names.

issues.description: Documentation shows status/body/meta while an anonymous request to the documented example API host returned root/meta with string code 10001.
issues.sdk_handling: Explicitly accept root/meta and body/meta, reject ambiguity, retain strict success codes and raw payload. No inference of authenticated success or user areaDomain.

issues.description: Firmware upgrade and upgrade-status HTTP examples use encrypt/off and validation-code fields unrelated to their Request Address tables.
issues.sdk_handling: Use the dedicated upgrade and upgrade/status paths and documented fields; never disable encryption as a prerequisite.

issues.description: Function description and error20010 refer to verification code, but request parameters and curl have none.
issues.sdk_handling: Follow the request table/example; do not infer an undocumented domestic field or claim absence of security proof.

issues.description: New-password length text is malformed (长度大超过12字节) while the request example has six ASCII characters.
issues.sdk_handling: Validate nonblank UTF8 only domestically; let the service enforce its actual length rule rather than inventing a bound.

issues.description: The enable-encryption section function description says Disable.
issues.sdk_handling: Use section title, encrypt/on path, and already-enabled60019 code; do not send encrypt/off.

issues.description: Request Address uses areaDomain but the HTTP example Host is open.ys7.com.
issues.sdk_handling: Route only through the configured client/token areaDomain.

issues.description: Arming/disarming HTTP example uses encrypt/off and validateCode.
issues.sdk_handling: Use defence/set and isDefence from Request Address and parameter table.

issues.description: Parameter table places deviceSerial in Header but curl puts it in form.
issues.sdk_handling: Use Header per table; no duplicate placement or automatic fallback.

issues.description: pageSize is both required and described as default 10.
issues.sdk_handling: Always send pageSize; SDK default is 10, range 1-50.

issues.description: Example response date strings do not match the request example month.
issues.sdk_handling: Return raw date strings; do not change dates or infer a timezone.

issues.description: The running-task query documents all task status values, including completed and cancelled.
issues.sdk_handling: Preserve every returned item and status; do not filter by the method name.

issues.description: For the tested Singapore account, the documented default auth origin returned 10017 while an explicit Singapore origin succeeded. This is account-specific live evidence, not proof that the default fails for every account.
issues.sdk_handling: Keep explicit regional auth_base_url configuration and returned areaDomain validation; never retry blindly across regions. Retain both live receipts.
